items.title: NVR (NVR) Stock Looks Fully Priced On Cash Flow Estimates
items.summary: NVR has seen its share price retreat in 2026, and that pullback puts fresh focus on a basic question for investors who follow the builder. Are today’s levels properly supported by the cash the business can generate over time, or has sentiment moved faster than the underlying economics of the homes it sells?
